items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: he was with me in '43, maybe early '44. That was my second time back at the Park Central, and I had a complete mixed band then.

ctx.x: Bert, B-e-r-t. Well, he was in the band at the same time that Trummy Young was. And of course they had quite a contest, because Eddie Bert was a very aggressive soloist, and as you know, so was Trummy. And it was a lot of fun, spelling them off against each other.
I've got to tell you a story about Trummy Young.

items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: when I left Lunceford I went with Barnet for a while... I imagine I was with Barnet about a year.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, she was with Barnet back there then. In fact, when I left Lunceford I went with Barnet for a while. I left Lunceford because he did too many one nighters. You know, it was really -- it would kill you almost, you know.
